correctness.rationale: A bounded morphism f of the finite reflexive total preorder must send each mutually accessible source cluster into one target cluster; forward condition forces a nondecreasing index map; successor equality f[U_i]=U_phi(i) forces a surjection onto a final target suffix. For each inverse block, the last source cluster must map surjectively onto its target cluster and earlier source clusters may map arbitrarily. Conversely these conditions give the back condition for all suffixes. Product of Stirling surjections Q(a_last,a_target) and free maps counts all maps; duality changes world-image length N_t to algebraic image cardinality 2^{N_t}. Bounded idempotents fix image suffix pointwise and send earlier points arbitrarily into its first cluster. For uniform r, block compositions yield Binomial(h-1,r!/(r!+r^r)) plus one. Independent direct exhaustive successor checks and rank counts for all world profiles <=5 matched formula (765 bounded morphisms), including dual algebraic-rank interpretation.
